datanalysis_env.status.backend: Local Python environment discovery. Uses configured and installed interpreter candidates.

outputs.detail: Optional copy of the discovery report, which is also printed to standard output.

datanalysis_env.status.warnings: A usable selection can coexist with warnings about other candidates. Package imports and notebook execution have their own healthcheck.
datanalysis_env.status.failure: When no dedicated environment is found, exits 1 and reports recovery guidance. It does not install an environment.

datanalysis_healthcheck.backend: The selected datanalysis interpreter checks imports. Jupyter support enables the optional temporary notebook smoke.

inputs.detail: Kernel used for the generated smoke notebook.
Check modules and imports without executing the notebook.

outputs.detail: Environment identity, module status, missing or failed imports, and notebook smoke status.
Diagnostic provenance and summary output record when requested.

datanalysis_healthcheck.warnings: A notebook smoke blocked by the host environment can yield WARNING. A skipped smoke records no notebook execution result.
datanalysis_healthcheck.failure: An incomplete stack or unsuccessful notebook smoke can exit 1 with a retained diagnostic report.

env_doctor.backend: Local Python, package metadata, interpreter discovery and installed tool checks.

inputs.detail: Exit 1 if any core dependency is missing, while retaining the diagnostic when its output path is usable.

outputs.detail: Core and optional dependency status, discovered backends and recommended actions.
Summary output and environment-readiness provenance.

env_doctor.warnings: Unavailable optional features can produce WARNING even when Core is ready.
env_doctor.failure: An invalid output destination can exit 2 with a controlled diagnostic on standard output. An independently writable summary path can retain it.

companion_route_check.backend: Local rule-based advisory routing in Python.

inputs.detail: Short task description used to match advisory routes.
Repeatable filename hint. The command uses its name and extension without reading the file.
Repeatable explicit format hint.

outputs.detail: Advisory recommendations, exclusions and routing policy. No plugins or connectors are started.

companion_route_check.warnings: An unmatched request produces WARNING and an empty recommendation list.
companion_route_check.failure: A summary path that overlaps a supplied file hint or cannot be written exits 2 with a diagnostic on standard output.

external_astro_tools_preflight.backend: Local Python discovery of optional Java, STILTS, TOPCAT and APT commands or packages.

inputs.detail: Explicit Java command for JAR routes.
Explicit STILTS executable or wrapper.
Explicit STILTS Java archive.
Explicit TOPCAT command.
Explicit TOPCAT Java archive.
Explicit APT command.
Saved preferences for reproducible APT batch mode.
Require a launchable STILTS route.
Require APT batch mode with its saved preferences.
Run short help or version probes for detected commands.

outputs.detail: Discovered backends, optional probe results, blocking findings and native alternatives.

external_astro_tools_preflight.warnings: Absent non-required backends can yield WARNING. Discovery without a probe verifies the selected path rather than executing a scientific job.
external_astro_tools_preflight.failure: A missing required backend exits 2 with blocking findings. This command does not perform catalog matching or photometry.

document_intake_workbench.backend: Core document readers. Deep PDF recovery and OCR depend on the installed format-specific tools.

inputs.detail: One or more readable documents or roots containing mixed document sets.
Request PDF recovery and OCR alongside normal semantic inspection.
Maximum number of discovered documents to inspect.

outputs.detail: Inventory CSV, report Markdown and per-document inspection products in a new directory.
Intake scope, document findings and partial or failed item evidence.
Discovered document inputs and completed output records.
App-ready bundle location with default summary and manifest destinations.

document_intake_workbench.warnings: Unreadable items, unsupported explicit files and discovery limits can produce partial intake findings.
document_intake_workbench.failure: An invalid input set or unsafe output path exits non-zero. A rejected operation can retain a diagnostic instead of an inventory.

office_roundtrip.docx-style-inventory.backend: Core with python-docx. Uses explicit character styles on DOCX runs.

inputs.detail: Readable document with explicit run formatting.
Select runs marked bold.
Select runs marked italic.
Select runs marked underlined.

outputs.detail: Selected styled runs with location and style.
Readable style inventory and its limitations.
Style requirements and match inventory, or the inspection diagnostic.
Source document and written reports.

office_roundtrip.docx-style-inventory.warnings: Zero matches can produce WARNING. Verify that an exported DOCX retains explicit run styles.
office_roundtrip.docx-style-inventory.failure: An unreadable DOCX can exit 2 with a retained inspection error.

office_roundtrip.docx-styled-replace.backend: Core with python-docx. Replaces exact text within matching individual runs and reads back the result.

inputs.detail: Readable source document preserved as input.
Exact text to find within a single run.
Exact replacement text.
Only replace in runs marked bold.
Only replace in runs marked italic.
Only replace in runs marked underlined.
Require an externally recorded approval identifier before writing.
Opaque identifier for the reviewed approval.

outputs.detail: Edited copy at a path separate from the source.
Touched runs, text differences and style readback.
Replacement counts, confirmation record, readback and limitations.
Source and written document and diff records.

office_roundtrip.docx-styled-replace.warnings: Text split across runs may yield zero replacements. Review the diff and the copied document.
office_roundtrip.docx-styled-replace.failure: Missing required confirmation, invalid input or unsafe paths can exit 2. A missing confirmation prevents writing the edited copy.

latex_workbench.scaffold.backend: Local Python renders LaTeX templates without invoking a TeX engine.

inputs.detail: Project title.
Author text for the scaffold.
Template language.
Supported LaTeX template family.
Explicit permission to replace scaffold-owned files in the output directory.

outputs.detail: LaTeX project source such as main.tex and bibliography support.
Template context, created files and detected collisions.
Scaffold parameters and written files.

latex_workbench.scaffold.warnings: The scaffold is a starting point for the report. It requires later content review and compilation.
latex_workbench.scaffold.failure: Existing scaffold files without overwrite permission exit 2 with collisions recorded.

latex_workbench.review.backend: Local Python inspects LaTeX references, structure and portability without compiling.

inputs.detail: Readable main TeX source or a directory containing a discoverable main document.

outputs.detail: Review of structure, includes, figures and bibliography.
Main document, detected structure and portability findings.
Inspected input and written review records.

latex_workbench.review.warnings: Missing references and portability issues require author review. Compilation is a separate capability.
latex_workbench.review.failure: Missing or unreadable project input can exit 2 with a review diagnostic.

scientific_writeup_review.backend: Local Python uses heuristic checks for scientific prose and follows supported TeX sources.

inputs.detail: Readable draft with enough scientific text to review sections, claims and methods.

outputs.detail: Author-facing review findings and checklist.
Sources, detected sections, metrics and review checklist.
Reviewed source records and completed outputs.

scientific_writeup_review.warnings: Methodology and claim checks are advisory. Review the draft and underlying evidence before acting on findings.
scientific_writeup_review.failure: Missing or insufficient source text can exit 2 with a controlled diagnostic.

deliverable_factory.scaffold.backend: Local Python generates a reusable deliverable template.

inputs.detail: Supported report, status, handoff or other template family.
Requested source format.
Title used in the generated file.
English, Spanish or bilingual template text.
Explicit permission to replace an existing scaffold target.

outputs.detail: Contains the generated deliverable source.
Scaffold parameters and written target.
Selected format, target, created files and collisions.

deliverable_factory.scaffold.warnings: Template fields require project-specific content before delivery.
deliverable_factory.scaffold.failure: An existing target without overwrite permission exits 2 with collision evidence.

semantic_diff.backend: Core table readers and document excerpt extraction, with format-specific readers when installed.

inputs.detail: Earlier version to compare.
Later version for the same comparison.

outputs.detail: Table changes or a bounded document text and metadata comparison.
Optional alternate JSON destination.
Readable comparison report.
Both source versions and completed outputs.

semantic_diff.warnings: Document comparisons use bounded extracted text. Inspect any reported completeness limits before drawing conclusions.
semantic_diff.failure: Missing or unreadable inputs can exit 2 with an error report.

profile_table.backend: Core with pandas or Astropy. The optional Dask reader supports out-of-core profiling for compatible formats.

inputs.detail: Readable table, such as CSV, TSV, ECSV, or a FITS table HDU.
Explicit Astropy reader format when suffix-based detection is insufficient.
Preferred compatible table reader.
FITS table HDU by name or zero-based index when applicable.
Maximum number of preview rows.
Maximum number of detailed column summaries.
Prefer out-of-core reads where available.
File-size threshold for automatic lazy profiling where supported.

outputs.detail: Reader, row and column counts, column profiles and bounded preview.
Source table and written summary records.
App-ready bundle location with default summary and manifest paths.

profile_table.warnings: Missingness and duplicate evidence are diagnostics. Original units are preserved as metadata where available.
profile_table.failure: A missing or unreadable table can exit 2 with a failure report. A summary destination that aliases the input is rejected before a write.

inspect_data_container.backend: Core covers ZIP and other standard-library readers. Structured formats can require their optional Python readers.

inputs.detail: Readable archive or supported HDF5, NetCDF, Zarr or other data container selected for inspection.

outputs.detail: Detected reader, container structure and bounded inspection evidence.
Alternate destination used when --summary-json is omitted.
Input and written inspection output records.
App-ready bundle location with default summary and manifest paths.

inspect_data_container.warnings: Archive warnings or a raw-byte fallback can yield WARNING. Inspection does not extract the archive.
inspect_data_container.failure: Missing input or a recognized format whose reader is unavailable can exit 2 with a blocked diagnostic.

physical_qa.backend: Core with NumPy and Astropy for FITS, and tabular readers for numeric columns.

inputs.detail: Readable input with available header or column metadata. Recognized names guide the bounded sanity checks.

outputs.detail: Issue list and metrics for recognizable physical quantities, such as angular bounds, signs and sample order.

physical_qa.warnings: Suspicious values remain visible as warnings and are never corrected by the check. Interpret metrics using the input quantity and its declared unit.
physical_qa.failure: A missing or unreadable dataset can exit 2 with a diagnostic. A path collision is refused before writing an output.

bootstrap_analysis_notebook.backend: Local Python generates notebook JSON. This command never executes the generated cells.

inputs.detail: Notebook title.
General, applied or astronomy template.
English, Spanish or bilingual scaffold text.
Local or Colab-style scaffold.
Optional source reference for the data-loading cell. The scaffold does not rewrite the source.
Name of the analysis output directory referenced in generated cells.
Explicit permission to replace an existing notebook at the output path.

outputs.detail: New notebook with setup, loading, analysis and export templates.
Scaffold settings, warnings and blocking findings.
Notebook creation settings and referenced data records.

bootstrap_analysis_notebook.warnings: An absolute, absent or nonportable data reference can yield WARNING while retaining a scaffold.
bootstrap_analysis_notebook.failure: An existing notebook without explicit overwrite, or an invalid output, exits 2 with an explanation.

coursework_notebook_fidelity_check.backend: Local Python inspects notebook JSON and readable assignment references without executing cells.

inputs.detail: Readable coursework notebook to audit.
Optional repeatable assignment or sidecar reference used to identify required materials.

outputs.detail: Readable findings and final delivery checks.
Notebook metadata, detected input and answer signals, findings and checklist.

coursework_notebook_fidelity_check.warnings: Heuristics flag missing answers, input requirements and portability risks for review.
coursework_notebook_fidelity_check.failure: A missing or unreadable notebook or assignment file can exit 2 with retained diagnostic details.

cross_domain_data_workbench.backend: Core table profiling. Optional query execution uses DuckDB when installed in the selected Python environment.

inputs.detail: One or more table files or folders to discover supported datasets.
Optional SQL against discovered inputs through the dedicated query backend.
Maximum preview rows per file profile.
Bound on the number of included table files.

outputs.detail: Profiles, overview report and optional query products in a new output folder.
Optional output path for query results.
Discovered files, total rows, profile status, input issues and query state.
Discovered input and completed output records.
App-ready bundle location with default summary and manifest paths.

cross_domain_data_workbench.warnings: Partial profiling and unavailable or unsuccessful optional SQL are recorded in the result.
cross_domain_data_workbench.failure: An unreadable input set, invalid output directory or output alias can exit 2. A rejected bundle is identified by its diagnostic.

notebook_branch_compare.backend: Local Python inventories branch products and groups likely equivalents.

inputs.detail: Folder containing branch directories or products named with branch suffixes.
Additional repeatable branch or suffix token.

outputs.detail: Contains branch_product_inventory.csv, branch_summary.csv, equivalent_products.csv and candidate_figures.md.
Branch inventory, equivalence groups, missing products, duplicates and candidate figures.

notebook_branch_compare.warnings: Missing and duplicate product groups require review. Grouping compares inventory evidence and names.
notebook_branch_compare.failure: A missing root or a non-directory root can exit 2 with a diagnostic.

inspect_fits.backend: Core with Astropy and NumPy. PNG quicklook uses Matplotlib. The limited NumPy fallback inspects the primary image.

inputs.detail: Readable original or copied FITS file with one or more HDUs.
HDU name or zero-based index for preview and pixel lookup.
Preview region as x0,y0,width,height. Its origin is zero-based.
Zero-based x,y in the original image. A cube uses its first plane. Values retain the declared BUNIT where available.
Additional FITS keyword to retain. May be repeated.
Positive approximate sample size for image statistics.
Maximum table columns described per HDU.
Requires --preview. Retains a diagnostic and summary if the bounded quicklook is unavailable.
Use the limited primary-image reader. Full HDU, WCS and pixel lookup support require Astropy.

outputs.detail: HDU descriptions, sampled data statistics, headers and available WCS.
Display-only quicklook when the selected image can be rendered.
Input and completed output records and processing parameters.

inspect_fits.warnings: Unavailable bounded quicklooks and low finite-pixel coverage can produce WARNING with a retained summary.
inspect_fits.failure: Unavailable or unreadable input and invalid coordinates can exit 2 with a diagnostic summary when its destination is writable.

catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.backend: Core with Astropy, NumPy and SciPy for nearest-neighbour celestial matching.

inputs.detail: Left catalog with at least one row and separate RA and Dec columns.
Right catalog with the same coordinate frame and epoch as the left catalog. The guided form accepts text tables.
Optional reader format for the left catalog.
Optional reader format for the right catalog.
Name of the RA column in the left catalog.
Name of the left declination column.
Name of the RA column in the right catalog.
Name of the right declination column.
Angular unit for the left RA column.
Angular unit for the right RA column.
Angular unit for the left Dec column.
Angular unit for the right Dec column.
ICRS for both inputs.
Positive common epoch if supplied. Required by the guided form. Positions are used as supplied.
Finite positive search radius up to 648000 arcseconds.

outputs.detail: Nearest accepted right-side match per left row, with match_sep_arcsec. The guided form writes ECSV.
Input and match counts, mapping and angular separation QA.
Both catalog input records, completed outputs and matching parameters.

catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.warnings: Empty matches, a search radius above one degree, and repeated use of one right row can yield WARNING.
catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.failure: Invalid input, coordinate metadata, or an unwritable destination can exit 2. Output aliases of inputs are rejected on standard output before writing any files.

photometry_noise_budget.backend: Python numerical model. No catalog, aperture image or external detector backend is required.

inputs.detail: Common unit of source, sky and dark counts.
Finite non-negative net source signal within the aperture.
Finite non-negative background sky level.
Finite non-negative integrated dark contribution.
Positive detector gain when using ADU.

inputs.unit: electrons RMS per pixel per frame
inputs.detail: Finite non-negative read noise in either input count unit mode.
Positive effective aperture area. Fractional pixels are supported.
Positive effective background sample area for the background-estimation variance term.
Positive integer count of combined frames.

outputs.detail: Variance components in electrons squared, total noise in electrons and dimensionless SNR.
Legacy summary destination used when --summary-json is absent.
Noise budget, assumptions and QA in a readable report.
Parameter and output records for the completed calculation.

photometry_noise_budget.warnings: Omitting background estimation or producing zero variance can yield WARNING. SNR is null when total noise is zero.
photometry_noise_budget.failure: Invalid values or numerical overflow exit 2. The diagnostic retains empty measurements and the reason.

astrometry_net_workbench.verify-existing.backend: The Full profile provides the supported Astropy and plotting stack. Local verification uses the existing FITS WCS and does not call an astrometric solver.

inputs.detail: Readable FITS with an existing celestial WCS. Image data in the selected HDU enables visual QA.

outputs.detail: Contains existing_wcs_quicklook.png when the selected WCS has a renderable image plane.
Center and corner sky positions in degrees, optional offset in arcseconds, and WCS round-trip residuals in pixels.
Existing WCS verification, caveats and reported diagnostics.
FITS input and completed verification output records.

astrometry_net_workbench.verify-existing.warnings: Header-only WCS or failed inverse round trips can yield WARNING. The check measures internal consistency without an independent catalog accuracy estimate.
astrometry_net_workbench.verify-existing.failure: A missing or unreadable file or absent celestial WCS can exit 2 with a diagnostic and empty measurements.

sb2_double_gaussian_workbench.fit.backend: Dedicated datanalysis environment with NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib. Fits two Gaussians per cross-correlation trace.

inputs.detail: One or more CCF tables with velocity_kms and ccf_value columns. Case and aperture metadata keep observations distinct.
Optional parsed FXCOR results for a loose comparison. May be repeated.
Override the case identifier for a set of orders belonging to the same observation.
Finite positive minimum accepted separation of the fitted components.

outputs.detail: Contains sb2_double_gaussian_orders.csv, summary.md and available PNG fit figures in figures/.
Per-order acceptance, velocities and uncertainties in km/s, and per-case component summaries.
CCF and optional FXCOR input records and completed output records.

sb2_double_gaussian_workbench.fit.warnings: Failed or rejected individual orders yield WARNING and retain their diagnostics. A rejected order contributes no fitted velocity to the accepted case summary.
sb2_double_gaussian_workbench.fit.failure: Invalid CCF or options can exit 2 before writing fit tables or figures. The summary retains input-validation issues where writable.

li6708_equivalent_width_workbench.measur.backend: Dedicated datanalysis environment with NumPy, Astropy and Matplotlib for local continuum fitting, integration and plotting.

inputs.detail: Spectrum in angstroms. ASCII uses wavelength and flux in the first two numeric columns.
Echelle aperture containing the line. Omitting it permits automatic order selection.
Rest wavelength around which to measure the line.
Label for the measurement and plot.
Optional target identifier.
Two endpoints of a continuum interval. May be repeated.
Two endpoints of the equivalent-width integral.
Polynomial degree for the local continuum.
Optional reference equivalent width supplied by the user.
Skip the window-perturbation grid. The grid uncertainty stays null and the noise proxy remains separate.

outputs.detail: Contains li6708_summary.csv, li6708_summary.md, the line plot and the default summary JSON on a completed measurement.
Equivalent width in angstroms and milliangstroms, integration settings, separate uncertainty diagnostics and QA. Overrides the default summary location.
Spectrum and completed output records with measurement parameters.

li6708_equivalent_width_workbench.measur.warnings: Review the continuum placement and sampling. The window-grid scatter and the random-like noise proxy measure different effects.
li6708_equivalent_width_workbench.measur.failure: Unsupported wavelength units or inadequate line or continuum data can exit 2 with diagnostic JSON and no completed measurement.

photometric_solution.backend: Core in the dedicated datanalysis environment. NumPy and pandas fit the model, with Astropy table support and Matplotlib for the residual plot.

inputs.detail: Standard-star table such as CSV, TSV, ECSV or FITS. Use one consistent magnitude system and passband per fit.
Instrumental magnitude column.
Catalog or standard magnitude column.
Airmass column for fitting extinction.
Color index column for the optional color term.
Positive uncertainty on the standard minus instrumental magnitude difference for weighted fitting.
Fit a linear color coefficient when the color column is supplied.

outputs.detail: Coefficients, method, uncertainties or null, residuals and QA.
Optional additional copy of the same summary.
Fitted coefficients with their units and uncertainties.
Per-standard fit diagnostics and residuals in mag.
Residual diagnostic plot.
Method, fit diagnostics and quality flags.
Input and completed output records for the solution.

photometric_solution.warnings: Sparse coverage, high residual scatter or uncertain coefficients can produce WARNING. The extinction sign follows the standard-minus-instrumental convention.
photometric_solution.failure: Unreadable, insufficient or rank-deficient standards can exit 2 with an empty coefficient set and a diagnostic.
